name: Miku
_about: A character stands at the bottom right of the visible window, her feet at x 480, y 377: halfway between the right end of BMW's speed (x ~355) and the window's right edge (605), with room on both sides. She comes from frames you bake yourself from a Live2D model with tools/live2d_bake and push to the car with scripts/deploy.sh --miku (they never go in this repo: the art belongs to its owner); without them nothing is drawn and the status row says so. Three effect layers stacked (shared/widgets/miku: back the tails and legs, mid the body, front the arms; one shader each, so each stays under the cluster's limits) sample the frame atlas, animated on the renderer's clock: blinks, breathing and swinging twin tails. She stands as on a bus: pulling away leans her right (the happy face when hard), braking leans her left (the braking face), and she straightens smoothly when the car settles; a hard pull held topples her: she stumbles a few steps that way until she is pressed against a wall (BMW's speed on the left, the window's edge on the right), stays there while the g lasts and walks back when it eases; speed blows her tails out. Modes: cruise keeps her where she is (BMW's ACC block is at x ~240..345); during route guidance BMW's turn map fills the right of the window and its street-name line crosses the left, so nav and cruiseNav draw nothing and BMW's HUD shows until the route ends.
